messages.subject: Parboot error message
parts:
Hi All, 

I am running parabt2 <- parboot(fit2, nsim=100) function in unmarked on camera trap data, however when i run this function including the covariate "elevation" it gives the error message:

Error in optim(starts,nll, method = method, hessian = se, . . .) : non-finite finite-difference value [2]

However parboot runs fine without the cov added so was just wondering what might be causing this error message as I can not find a solution.

Thank you for your time!

Kind regards,
Tristan
